skills.name: roboagent-run-model
skills.displayName: Run a QNN Model on Windows on Snapdragon
skills.description: Run an ExecuTorch .pte model built for the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct (QNN) backend on a Windows on Snapdragon PC: simple operator tests with qnn_executor_runner, or large language models such as Gemma with qnn_llama_runner.
useCases: Run this .pte model on my Snapdragon PC
Benchmark LLM tokens per second with qnn_llama_runner
Validate my QNN model with a simple operator test
Run Gemma on the NPU of my Windows on Snapdragon laptop
Why does my .pte file load but produce wrong output?

skills.name: roboagent-setup
skills.displayName: ExecuTorch QNN Build Setup on Windows on Snapdragon
skills.description: Set up the ExecuTorch and Qualcomm AI Engine Direct (QNN) backend build environment natively on a Windows on Snapdragon ARM64 PC (no cross-compile, no adb: the PC is both host and target) for RoboAgent, an ExecuTorch QNN playground.
useCases: Set up the ExecuTorch QNN build environment on my Snapdragon PC
Check prerequisites before building a QNN runner
Prepare this device as both host and target for QNN
What do I install before building ExecuTorch with the QNN backend on Windows?
Verify my QAIRT 2.51 install is visible to the ExecuTorch build
Why does the ExecuTorch QNN build fail on my ARM64 Windows PC?
